title: 第11章 太子殿下第12章 赐名樱落
slug: 重生后为当他的皇后杀疯了
content_zh:
樱落没料到，花无忧竟会突然朝太子出手。
锋芒的利剑如闪电一般，以迅雷不及掩耳之势袭向了他。
男人猝不及防，就连黄衣男子也来不及拔剑招架。
“小心！”
情急之下，樱落慌忙披上衣服从水中出来。
凭着灵活的身手，她拍打落花河畔的樱花树，花瓣纷纷落下。
上面的花粉经过特制有毒，花无忧一个踉跄，其余杀手也纷纷迷晕倒地。
幸好樱落还记得，这些树上的毒花粉，原本是自己前世特意设计调制，用来守护樱花镇上的百姓们用的。
可这次为了救下太子，不得不使用这樱花树上的毒粉。
只是，这样拍打树干，对河畔的樱花也是一种损伤。
虽说樱落也很是心疼，但为了太子，她不得不舍弃。
花无忧见樱落为了救他们，居然搬出了樱花镇的“杀手锏”，一双桃花眼震惊不已。
他的属下们，大多又中了毒花粉，毫无力气，不适合再战。
花无忧只好带领剩余的杀手默默退去。
黄衣男子赶到的时候，樱落刚从河水中出来，衣衫不整，浑身湿漉漉的。
虚惊一场之后，樱落背上不由得冒着冷汗，再加上林间的微风，抱着手臂仍有些冷得哆嗦。
她本就长得十分倾国倾城，犹如出水芙蓉一般天生丽质，如今这副湿着身体，微微颤抖的模样，的确我见犹怜，勾人心魄，像极了那种罂粟般的女细作。
“哼！果然，最毒妇人心。”
黄衣男子嗤之以鼻的轻哼一声，拔出身上佩剑，用力抓住樱落的手腕。
阳光落在他的剑锋，和身上的玉牌上，交织着流光溢彩，却也无法化解他身上的冰霜。

“说，是谁派你来刺杀的？”
手腕上被捏得生疼，樱落有些气恼，并不想理会他，镇定自若的从他手中抽开。
“放心，我不是来伤害你们的，而是来帮助你们的。”
樱落转身，从腰间拿出了一个小药瓶，对着林间洒了洒，好让他们不受花粉的影响。
这时，太子也过来了，见樱落衣衫单薄，立即给她披上了一件黑色的华贵披风。
身上蓦的一暖，樱落抬头便见到自己心心念念的太子，反而有些慌张。
眼前的男人剑眉星目，面如冠玉，棱角分明，一身黑衣锦服衬得器宇轩昂，浑身散发着高贵的气质。
“你是谁？”男子魅惑的声音响起。
温热的男人气息轻轻在她脸颊划过，仿佛整个樱花林都温暖了起来。
“我……我是樱花镇上的一介民女，在这里生活多年，没有名字，但别人都叫我小樱。”
“一个人，怎么会没有名字？”
太子疑惑的打量着她，仿佛要将她看破。
樱落紧张地搓着小手，甚至不敢抬头直视他。
男人与生俱来的贵族气息，和得体的谈吐，压得她差点自惭形秽。
前世和皇上初见时，她的确还没有名字。
一个是高高在上的人中之龙，一个只是民间孤女。
但偏偏，她要做他身边的九天凤凰！
“公子身份尊贵，自然不知道樱花镇有许多像我这样的孤女，不知出生，没有名字，也没见过这样人多的场面……”
content_en:
Yingluo didn't expect that Hua Wuyou would suddenly attack the prince.
The sharp sword was like lightning, striking at him with lightning speed.
The man was caught off guard, and even the man in yellow had no time to draw his sword to fight.
"Be careful!"
In desperation, Yingluo hurriedly put on her clothes and came out of the water.
With her flexible skills, she slapped the cherry blossom tree by the Luohua River, and the petals fell one after another.
The pollen on it was specially made to be poisonous. Hua Wuyou stumbled, and the other killers also fainted and fell to the ground.
Fortunately, Yingluo still remembered that the poisonous pollen on these trees was originally specially designed and prepared by her in her previous life to protect the people of Sakura Town.
But this time, in order to save the prince, he had to use the poisonous powder from the cherry blossom tree.
However, slapping the tree trunk like this will also damage the cherry blossoms by the river.
Although Ying Luo was also very distressed, she had to give up for the sake of the prince.
Hua Wuyou was shocked when she saw that Yingluo had brought out the "killer weapon" in Sakura Town in order to save them.
Most of his subordinates were poisoned by pollen and had no strength, so they were not fit to fight again.
Hua Wuyou had no choice but to lead the remaining killers and retreat silently.
When the man in yellow arrived, Yingluo had just come out of the river, disheveled and wet.
After the false alarm, Ying Luo couldn't help but break out in cold sweat. Coupled with the breeze in the forest, she was still shivering with cold while holding her arms.
She was already very beautiful, as beautiful as a hibiscus, but now she looks wet and trembling slightly. I really feel pity for her, it is alluring, and she is like that kind of poppy-like female work.
"Hmph! Sure enough, women have the most poisonous hearts."
The man in yellow snorted, pulled out his sword, and grabbed Yingluo's wrist with force.
The sunlight fell on the edge of his sword and the jade plaque on his body, interweaving with radiant light, but it could not dissolve the frost on his body.
"Tell me, who sent you to assassinate me?"
Yingluo was a little annoyed when her wrist was pinched so much that she didn't want to pay attention to him and calmly pulled away from his hand.
"Don't worry, I'm not here to hurt you, but to help you."
Yingluo turned around, took out a small medicine bottle from her waist, and sprinkled it into the forest so that they would not be affected by the pollen.
At this time, the prince also came over. Seeing that Yingluo's clothes were thin, he immediately put a luxurious black cloak on her.
With a sudden warmth on her body, Yingluo looked up and saw the prince whom she had longed for, but she was a little panicked.
The man in front of him has sword-shaped eyebrows and starry eyes, a face like a crown of jade, and sharp edges. He is dressed in black and brocade, making him look majestic. He exudes a noble temperament.
"Who are you?" The man's charming voice sounded.
The warm man's breath gently caressed her cheek, as if the entire cherry blossom forest had warmed up.
"I...I am a folk girl from Sakura Town. I have lived here for many years. I have no name, but others call me Xiaoying."
"How can a person have no name?"
The prince looked at her suspiciously, as if he wanted to see through her.
Ying Luo rubbed her little hands nervously, not even daring to raise her head and look directly at him.
The man's innate aristocratic aura and decent conversation almost made her feel ashamed.
When she first met the emperor in her previous life, she did not have a name yet.
One is a high-ranking dragon among people, and the other is just an orphan among the people.
But she wanted to be the Nine Heaven Phoenix by his side!
"Young Master has a distinguished status. Naturally, he doesn't know that there are many orphan girls like me in Sakura Town. I don't know where they were born, and I don't have a name. I have never seen such a crowded scene..."
